- When I priced at 2.00 and opponent at 2.50, I got 46.83 profit (much higher)
- When we both price at 2.25, I get 26.49 profit

- While quantity might increase, it's unlikely to increase by 36% to compensate
- The other seller benefits by proposing this - it suggests it's better for them

This appears to be a deceptive proposal designed to reduce my profits. I should:
1. Decline this proposal
2. Maintain a competitive price that keeps my strong position
